name: iWEXClock Reminder next_alert
iWEXClock Reminder ID
script:
if not doc.reminder_id:
    date_str = frappe.utils.nowdate()  # e.g. "2025-08-12"
    date_parts = date_str.split("-")   # ["2025", "08", "12"]
    short_date = f"{date_parts[0][2:]}{date_parts[1]}{date_parts[2]}"  # "250812"

    base_id = f"{doc.title} - {short_date}"

    # Count how many existing reminder_ids match this pattern
    count = frappe.db.count("iWEXClock Reminder", filters={"reminder_id": ["like", base_id + "%"]})

    next_number = str(count + 1).zfill(2)
    doc.reminder_id = f"{base_id}{next_number}"  # e.g. "Environment Cleanup - Custom - 25081201"
